policy: Text-only public copy. Internal absolute roots use explicit placeholders. Detailed Cargo artifact/environment records and all full Callgrind profiles (original and normalized) are withheld locally. Original SHA values refer to original stored bytes. Readable summaries, numeric work records and native measurement rows remain public.
